sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Govt. Civil Sectt. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
3.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.540 of 2022, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Pratapgarh.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that in terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant on 27.06.2020 and sufficient dowry was also given.

entities.text: Ashwani Patel @ Babloo vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Subsequently, on 09.06.2022, entire matrimonial family had killed the victim.
The postmortem on record indicates ten injuries including injury on the skull which is also the cause of death.

It is argued by counsel for the applicant that three of the co-accused i.e. father-in-law, mother-in-law &
sister-in-law were enlarged on bail vide separate orders which are on record as Annexure - 9.
5.

While arguing the present bail application by the applicant who is the husband, learned counsel for the applicant states that the trial is not proceeding as is evident from the order-sheet filed alongwith the supplementary affidavit which demonstrates that not even one witness has been examined so far despite the fact that summons are being issued constantly.
6. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

7. Considering the fact that the applicant is in custody since 10.06.2022 and the prosecution witnesses are not recorded coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Ashwani Patel @ Babloo be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
